SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q17. The first printing press came to India with which of the following missionaries?  
(A) Portuguese  
(B) French  

(C) Dutch  
(D) English

Answer / Solution:
The first printing press came to India with which of the following missionaries? 
(A) Portuguese 
Reasoning: It came to Goa with Portuguese missionaries in the mid-16th 
century.
